about.description: eduID.africa is the pan-African identity federation connecting the continent's research and education community to each other and to the world. Jointly governed by Africa's three regional research and education networks.

networksSection.headline: Three networks. One framework.
networksSection.description: eduID.africa is jointly governed by Africa's three regional research and education networks, each covering a distinct region of the continent.

network1.fullName: UbuntuNet Alliance for Research and Education Networking

network2.fullName: West and Central African Research and Education Network

network3.fullName: Arab States Research and Education Network

mission.headline: Two levels. One framework.
mission.description: eduID.africa operates at two interconnected levels that together define what makes it structurally different from a single national federation.

level1.title: Level 1 — Continental framework
level1.description: eduID.africa is the continental roof: a pan-African identity federation that connects to eduGAIN and gives African researchers, students, and staff access to digital services globally. It sets the standards, governs the trust framework, and represents Africa's R&E identity ecosystem internationally.

level2.title: Level 2 — National federation support
level2.description: The primary delivery model is to help each NREN establish and operate its own national identity federation — country sovereignty over identity infrastructure, with eduID.africa as the continental aggregator above. This is the path of preference.

level2b.title: Level 2b — Catchall for those that cannot yet
level2b.description: For NRENs that lack institutional capacity, funding, or critical mass to run a national federation, eduID.africa operates a catchall. BonafID is the enabling platform: cloud-hosted, open-source federated IAM for any institution.

step1.title: eduID.africa established
step1.description: Continental catch-all federation launched under the AfricaConnect programme, providing a first path to eduGAIN for African institutions.

step2.title: AfricaConnect3 — BonafID piloted
step2.description: First BonafID pilots begin across the WACREN region. Campus identity governance model proven. Seven pilot institutions across five countries.

step3.title: T&I Roadshow programme launched
step3.description: Structured regional workshops begin driving HEI adoption across West, East, and Southern Africa. National federations begin forming in Kenya, South Africa, and Ghana.

step4.title: AfricaConnect4 — Production phase
step4.description: BonafID 1.0 production release. Regional geteduroam deployed. 12 national federations operational. 380+ connected institutions across 35 countries.

step5.title: Scale
step5.description: Phase targets: 25 national federations, self-service onboarding, French and Arabic language content, LIBSENSE open science integration.

howItWorks.description: eduID.africa operates across three interconnected layers — campus identity governance, national federation, and continental aggregation — connecting African researchers and students to global resources.

card1.title: BonafID — Campus identity governance
card1.description: Most African HEIs lack a managed identity provider. BonafID is an open-source IAM system, co-created by WACREN, that gives each institution a production-ready identity provider. A unified, lifelong identity for every student and staff member — that works across institutions and countries.
card1.solves: fragmented credentials, no managed IdP, locked out of global resources

card2.title: eduID.africa — Continental federation
card2.description: The regional identity federation connecting African HEIs to each other and, via eduGAIN, to the global research and education network. NRENs can build sovereign national federations that connect upward — or institutions can participate directly via the catchall federation.
card2.solves: no path to global research access, fragmented national infrastructure

card3.title: geteduroam — Certificate-based Wi-Fi
card3.description: A regional service that uses a user's federated identity to automatically generate a Wi-Fi login certificate via a simple app. No manual configuration. Secure, RADIUS-over-TLS authenticated access across every connected campus in the region.
card3.solves: eduroam configuration complexity, legacy authentication protocols

architecturePaths.headline: Where your country fits
architecturePaths.description: Two paths to the continental federation — both valid, both connected upward to eduGAIN and the global R&E network.

pathA.title: Path A — National federation
pathA.description: NREN operates a sovereign national federation. Institutions in that country register with the NREN. The national federation peers with eduID.africa at the continental level.
pathA.bestFor: Best for NRENs with institutional capacity and critical mass

pathB.title: Path B — Catchall federation
pathB.description: Institutions participate directly in the continental federation via BonafID. No NREN-level federation required. This is the on-ramp — not a permanent endpoint.
pathB.bestFor: Best for NRENs not yet ready to operate national infrastructure

hero.title: For NRENs
hero.subtitle: Sovereign identity infrastructure, governance frameworks, training roadshows, and continental peering for Africa's National Research and Education Networks.

overview.description: Two paths to the continental federation. Whether your NREN is ready to operate a national identity federation or still building toward it — eduID.africa supports both, with tooling, governance frameworks, and direct programme support.

sovereignSection.headline: Your NREN owns the infrastructure.
sovereignSection.description: The path of preference. Your country operates a sovereign national identity federation — with eduID.africa providing the continental roof above it. Your institutions register with your NREN; your NREN peers with eduID.africa.

featureA.title: Governance sovereignty
featureA.desc: Your country sets the trust framework, membership criteria, and policies for your national federation. eduID.africa operates at the continental level only.

featureB.title: Tooling and technical support
featureB.desc: eduID.africa provides governance templates, federation software, peering documentation, and technical support for NREN-led deployments.

featureC.title: T&I Roadshow programme
featureC.desc: Regional workshops drive adoption in-country — helping your NREN build the institutional membership base that makes a national federation viable.

checklistSection.headline: What's needed to start
checklistSection.intro: eduID.africa's assessment team will review your NREN's readiness across these areas before the deployment engagement begins.
items: Mandated NREN with government backing or HEI sector agreement
Minimum 5–10 institutions willing to deploy BonafID or existing IdPs
Technical staff (at least one) to own federation operations
Willingness to adopt eduID.africa's trust framework policies
Basic server infrastructure or cloud access for federation metadata hosting

callout.title: Not ready for Path A yet?

benefitsSection.title: What your institution gains
benefitsSection.description: Federation is not just a technical infrastructure project — it unlocks real services for your students, researchers, and staff from day one.

items.title: eduroam Wi-Fi roaming
items.desc: Your students and staff connect automatically to Wi-Fi at any of the 10,000+ eduroam-enabled institutions worldwide, using their institutional credentials.

items.title: Global research resources
items.desc: eduGAIN membership unlocks access to thousands of international research platforms, library databases, and collaboration tools via verified institutional identity.

items.title: Lifelong institutional identity
items.desc: BonafID provides each user a unified identity that persists across degree programmes, departments, and career stages — portable across institutions.

items.title: Simplified IT management
items.desc: Centralised identity governance replaces fragmented per-service credentials. One identity provider. One audit trail. Consistent access controls across all services.

items.title: NREN platform access
items.desc: Your institution's federated identity is the key to NREN-provided services: video conferencing, cloud storage, learning platforms, and more.

items.title: No on-premise infrastructure
items.desc: BonafID is cloud-hosted. Your IT team does not need to operate servers or manage certificates. WACREN handles the infrastructure; you manage identities.

connectSection.title: How to connect your institution
connectSection.description: The process is structured and supported. WACREN's T&I team provides guidance at each stage.

steps.title: Initial assessment
steps.description: WACREN conducts a readiness assessment of your institution's current identity infrastructure and data systems. This scopes the BonafID deployment.

steps.title: Data integration
steps.description: BonafID's data extraction tools connect to your existing student information system, HR system, or LDAP. No manual data entry.

steps.title: IdP deployment and testing
steps.description: Your BonafID identity provider is deployed and tested against eduID.africa's federation metadata. WACREN's team supports remotely.

steps.title: Federation registration
steps.description: Your institution's IdP is registered in the federation. From this point, your users can access federated services and request geteduroam certificates.

steps.title: Live — staff and students connected
steps.description: Your institution appears in the coverage directory. Students and staff can download geteduroam and access eduGAIN resources immediately.

supportSection.title: Support throughout
supportSection.description: Deployment is not a solo exercise. eduID.africa's programme team provides structured support from assessment to go-live.

items.title: T&I Roadshows
items.description: Hands-on regional workshops for HEI IT administrators. Covers BonafID deployment, federation concepts, and geteduroam rollout.

items.title: Remote deployment support
items.description: WACREN's T&I team provides remote assistance during BonafID installation, data integration, and federation registration.

items.title: Documentation and guides
items.description: Step-by-step deployment guides, API documentation, and BonafID configuration reference — all available in the resources section.

ctaSection.title: Ready to start the onboarding process?
ctaSection.description: Contact the eduID.africa team to schedule your initial assessment. If there's a T&I Roadshow upcoming in your region, that's the fastest path to a supported deployment.

hero.title: BonafID
hero.subtitle: Sovereign cloud identity and verifiable academic credentials for African students, researchers, and faculties.

overview.description: BonafID is a cloud-hosted, open-source federated IAM platform co-created by WACREN and partners. It gives any institution a production-grade identity provider — without on-premise servers, without specialist staffing, and without waiting for national infrastructure to exist.

problemSection.title: The problem BonafID exists to fix
problemSection.description: Most African HEIs cannot participate in the federation because they have no managed identity provider. Building and operating one from scratch — servers, certificates, staff — is beyond most institutions' IT capacity. BonafID removes that barrier entirely.

items.title: No infrastructure required
items.desc: Cloud-hosted. WACREN operates the platform. Your IT team manages identities only.

items.title: Integrates with existing systems
items.desc: Data extraction tools connect BonafID to your SIS, HR system, or LDAP without manual migration.

items.title: Federation-ready from day one
items.desc: Registered in eduID.africa's federation on deployment. Instantly eligible for eduGAIN and geteduroam.

items.title: Lifelong identity
items.desc: Each user gets a persistent identity that travels with them — across institutions, programmes, and career stages.
